entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Oleksii Petrovych Poroshenko is a Ukrainian politician and diplomat. He is a former People's Deputy of Ukraine and is the son of former president and business magnate Petro Poroshenko, who has transferred major assets to his son since losing power in 2019.
